findings.reason: Facts [F2] and Proof 1.1 use the cap map as the adjoint of the cup inclusion and claim orthogonal path matrix units. The root-fusion supplier proves the cap map β and βα = λp, but does not establish β = α* or self-adjointness of the JW projectors. Locally prove that horizontal reflection fixes the projectors by their real-coefficient recursion and sends α to β; also show the generated ideal and trace radical are reflection-stable. Then the normalized path maps are isometries and the quotient inherits the claimed C*-structure, supporting positivity of the expectation. No interface change is needed.
